findings: Partition one candidate vector. extract_detection_candidates walks Detection2DArray.detections in order and stores source_index as that slot. It keeps a detection only when results is non-empty and the highest-scoring hypothesis matches the target class. select_detection returns one of those candidates. That candidate's bbox and source_index are the only inputs to stage 2. deferred_source_indices is every other candidate's source_index, in that same order. A second pallet that does not overlap the winner stays in the deferred list. A tied strategy key still yields one winner; the other tied slot stays deferred.

On a successful estimate, write both sides onto PalletPoseStamped, the pose the AGV controller reads. Add int32 stage2_source_index and int32[] deferred_source_indices. input_rgb_stamp and input_depth_stamp are already the detection header stamp and the depth header stamp of this ApproximateTime pair, so the roster is this capture. The pose header.stamp is the publish time. Detection2D.id is an optional cross-message label and may be empty; the slot used here is source_index.

On stage-2 failure, publish no PalletPoseStamped. Append the same two lists to the existing WARN DiagnosticStatus as KeyValue strings: one stage2_source_index, and one deferred_source_index for each deferred slot, decimal text, in the same order. That status already carries input_rgb_stamp and input_depth_stamp. Keep name pps_pallet_pose_cpp, hardware_id dynamic_handling_ros_v1, level WARN, and the failure message. REP-107 KeyValues are the string encoding for this diagnostic, which is the only result this path publishes.

Leave the two silent returns unchanged. An empty candidate list publishes nothing. A depth-conversion exception publishes nothing. A single class-matched candidate still publishes stage2_source_index and an empty deferred list, on PalletPoseStamped when the estimate succeeds and on the WARN status when it fails. estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 runs once.
